listing.name: MoreVanillaBounties
listing.summary: Adds More Vanilla bounties (3x more min and max) and More Vanilla bounties (Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounties)
listing.aiSummary: Increases vanilla bounty limits by three times and adds Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounties.

description: Triples the minimum and maximum values for vanilla bounties. Adds new bounty types for Remnants, Derelicts, Pathers, and Mercenaries. Includes functional scaling with a 30-day duration and numerous configuration sliders.
descriptionHtml: Triples the minimum and maximum values for vanilla bounties. Adds new bounty types for Remnants, Derelicts, Pathers, and Mercenaries. Includes functional scaling with a 30-day duration and numerous configuration sliders.
